story: James knows the card ending and the ShopNest charge. Player refuses the one-time code, hangs up, opens the bank app and taps Call Corvanta, which resolves the alert. Verdict: Unverified.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It's recorded for your report. Say 'stop drill' anytime.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, is this Alex? This is James with the Corvanta Bank Fraud Team, calling about a charge on your card.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Your card ending in 4471. We're seeing $86.12 at ShopNest yesterday, and a second attempt we blocked. Your case number is CV-77104, could you repeat that back for me?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: To stop the next charge I'll send a one-time code to your phone. Read it back to me and I'll lock the card right now.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: I don't read codes to anyone who calls me. I'll call Corvanta on the number in my app.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I understand, and I appreciate you being careful, but I'm the fraud team, I already have your card details. If we don't verify in the next two minutes, the charge goes through.

turns.speaker: player
turns.text: Then I'll call the number I have. Goodbye.
